command:
set -eu
PKG=io.blueeye
SERVICE=io.blueeye/io.blueeye.service.ScannerService
OUT=/tmp/tracker-phase2-device-clean-r2
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT/db-before" "$OUT/db-after"

adb start-server >/dev/null
SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$SERIAL" ] || { adb devices -l; echo DEVICE_GATE=FAIL; exit 31; }
adbx(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
echo SERIAL=$SERIAL
echo MODEL=$(adbx shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')
echo ANDROID=$(adbx shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r') SDK=$(adbx shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')

if ! adbx shell run-as $PKG id >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo RUN_AS=FAIL; exit 32; fi
echo RUN_AS=PASS

service_count(){ adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true; }
app_start(){ adbx shell run-as $PKG am start-foreground-service -a ACTION_START -n $SERVICE; }

snapshot_db(){
  dest=$1; mkdir -p "$dest"
  LIST=$(adbx shell run-as $PKG ls -1 databases 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)
  printf '%s\n' "$LIST" | while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    adbx exec-out run-as $PKG cat "databases/$f" > "$dest/$f" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$dest/$f"
  done
}
inspect_db(){
  python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,sys,json
d=sys.argv[1]; ok=False
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    if f.endswith(('-wal','-shm','-journal')): continue
    p=os.path.join(d,f)
    if not os.path.isfile(p): continue
    try:
        c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True)
        integ=c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
        tables=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%' order by name")]
        counts={t:c.execute('select count(*) from "'+t.replace('\"','\"\"')+'"').fetchone()[0] for t in tables}
        print('DB_STATE',json.dumps({'file':f,'integrity':integ,'tables':counts},sort_keys=True)); c.close()
        if integ=='ok': ok=True
    except Exception as e:
        print('DB_READ_ERROR',f,str(e))
if not ok: raise SystemExit(40)
PY
}

# Clean baseline; preserve all app data.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 2
adbx shell svc bluetooth enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 5
BASE_SERVICE=$(service_count); echo BASE_SERVICE=$BASE_SERVICE
[ "$BASE_SERVICE" -eq 0 ] || { echo BASE_GATE=FAIL_SERVICE_ACTIVE; exit 34; }
snapshot_db "$OUT/db-before"
inspect_db "$OUT/db-before" | tee "$OUT/db-before.txt"
adbx logcat -c

# Launching the Activity alone must not start scanning.
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 4
IDLE_SERVICE=$(service_count); echo IDLE_SERVICE=$IDLE_SERVICE
[ "$IDLE_SERVICE" -eq 0 ] || { echo IDLE_GATE=FAIL_AUTO_START; exit 35; }
echo IDLE_GATE=PASS

# Explicit app-UID ACTION_START (same internal service command as the Play button).
app_start | tee "$OUT/start-command.txt"
sleep 7
START_SERVICE=$(service_count)
START_EVENTS=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN_EVENTS=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo START_SERVICE=$START_SERVICE START_EVENTS=$START_EVENTS RUN_EVENTS=$RUN_EVENTS
[ "$START_SERVICE" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RUN_EVENTS" -ge 1 ] || { echo EXPLICIT_START_GATE=FAIL; exit 36; }
echo EXPLICIT_START_GATE=PASS

# Bluetooth OFF must tear down; Bluetooth ON alone must not restart.
adbx shell svc bluetooth disable >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo BT_TOGGLE=UNSUPPORTED; exit 37; }
sleep 8
BT_OFF_EVENT=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=BLUETOOTH_OFF' || true)
BT_OFF_SERVICE=$(service_count)
START_BEFORE_ON=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
echo BT_OFF_EVENT=$BT_OFF_EVENT BT_OFF_SERVICE=$BT_OFF_SERVICE START_BEFORE_ON=$START_BEFORE_ON
[ "$BT_OFF_EVENT" -ge 1 ] && [ "$BT_OFF_SERVICE" -eq 0 ] || { echo BT_OFF_GATE=FAIL; exit 38; }
echo BT_OFF_GATE=PASS

adbx shell svc bluetooth enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 10
BT_ON_SERVICE=$(service_count)
START_AFTER_ON=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
echo BT_ON_SERVICE=$BT_ON_SERVICE START_AFTER_ON=$START_AFTER_ON
[ "$BT_ON_SERVICE" -eq 0 ] && [ "$START_AFTER_ON" = "$START_BEFORE_ON" ] || { echo BT_ON_GATE=FAIL_AUTO_RESTART; exit 39; }
echo BT_ON_GATE=PASS

# Explicit restart once Bluetooth is back.
app_start >/dev/null; sleep 7
BT_RESTART_SERVICE=$(service_count); echo BT_RESTART_SERVICE=$BT_RESTART_SERVICE
[ "$BT_RESTART_SERVICE" -eq 1 ] || { echo BT_RESTART_GATE=FAIL; exit 41; }
echo BT_RESTART_GATE=PASS

# Background/foreground must preserve the same service without new lifecycle start.
S0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
R0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
PID0=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r')
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME; sleep 6
PIDBG=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SBG=$(service_count)
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 4
S1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
R1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo BG_PID=$PID0/$PIDBG BG_SERVICE=$SBG START=$S0/$S1 RUN=$R0/$R1
[ "$PID0" = "$PIDBG" ] && [ "$SBG" -eq 1 ] && [ "$S0" = "$S1" ] && [ "$R0" = "$R1" ] || { echo BG_GATE=FAIL; exit 42; }
echo BG_GATE=PASS

# Process force-stop/relaunch: no auto-start; explicit internal start restores scanner.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 4
PSTOP=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SSTOP=$(service_count); echo FORCE_STOP_PID="$PSTOP" FORCE_STOP_SERVICE=$SSTOP
[ -z "$PSTOP" ] && [ "$SSTOP" -eq 0 ] || { echo PROCESS_STOP_GATE=FAIL; exit 43; }
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 4
SREL=$(service_count); echo RELAUNCH_SERVICE=$SREL
[ "$SREL" -eq 0 ] || { echo PROCESS_RELAUNCH_GATE=FAIL_AUTO_START; exit 44; }
app_start >/dev/null; sleep 7
SREST=$(service_count); echo PROCESS_EXPLICIT_SERVICE=$SREST
[ "$SREST" -eq 1 ] || { echo PROCESS_EXPLICIT_GATE=FAIL; exit 45; }
echo PROCESS_GATE=PASS

# Screen sleep/wake: same process/service and no extra start/running transitions.
S0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
R0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
PID0=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r')
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP; sleep 12
PIDS=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SSLEEP=$(service_count)
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 5
S1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
R1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo SCREEN_PID=$PID0/$PIDS SCREEN_SERVICE=$SSLEEP START=$S0/$S1 RUN=$R0/$R1
[ "$PID0" = "$PIDS" ] && [ "$SSLEEP" -eq 1 ] && [ "$S0" = "$S1" ] && [ "$R0" = "$R1" ] || { echo SCREEN_GATE=FAIL; exit 46; }
echo SCREEN_GATE=PASS

# Final DB integrity after lifecycle stress.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 2
snapshot_db "$OUT/db-after"
inspect_db "$OUT/db-after" | tee "$OUT/db-after.txt"
echo DB_GATE=PASS

python3 - "$OUT/db-before" "$OUT/db-after" <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,sys,json
def stats(d):
    out={}
    for f in os.listdir(d):
        if f.endswith(('-wal','-shm','-journal')): continue
        p=os.path.join(d,f)
        try:
            c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True)
            tabs=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%' order by name")]
            out[f]={t:c.execute('select count(*) from "'+t.replace('\"','\"\"')+'"').fetchone()[0] for t in tabs}; c.close()
        except Exception: pass
    return out
print('DB_BEFORE_COUNTS',json.dumps(stats(sys.argv[1]),sort_keys=True))
print('DB_AFTER_COUNTS',json.dumps(stats(sys.argv[2]),sort_keys=True))
PY

# Leave app foreground, scanner intentionally stopped.
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null || true
adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService:|AndroidRuntime:.*io.blueeye|ANR in io.blueeye' | tail -1200 > "$OUT/final-log.txt" || true
python3 - "$OUT/final-log.txt" <<'PY'
import sys
s=open(sys.argv[1],errors='ignore').read()
print('APP_FATAL_COUNT',s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION')); print('APP_ANR_COUNT',s.count('ANR in io.blueeye'))
if 'FATAL EXCEPTION' in s or 'ANR in io.blueeye' in s: raise SystemExit(47)
PY
echo REPORT_DIR=$OUT
echo CLEAN_DEVICE_FLOW_R2=PASS
